data.description: Flexible alternative to Option (d) Gatekeeper that validates questions based on seeing option (d) OR ≥2 options. Useful for formats with inconsistent option counts or OCR errors. Current Gatekeeper works perfectly for Vision IAS (100/100 accuracy), so this is only needed if we encounter PDFs with missing option (d) or support multiple exam formats.

The vision_ias_questions profile skips page 1 assuming it contains instructions. However, some PDFs (e.g., VP_TEST-14) have questions starting on page 1. Need to auto-detect whether first page is instructions or actual questions to avoid missing Q1-Q8.
data.title: Auto-detect instruction page vs question page on first page

data.description: Current gatekeeper expects strict Q1,Q2,Q3 sequence. If pages are missing (e.g., scanned pages with no text), it stops. Add MAX_GAP_TOLERANCE config to skip missing questions and resume extraction when valid question numbers are found within tolerance range.
data.title: Add gap recovery to gatekeeper assembly strategy

data.description: Add OCR support for image-based PDF pages. Use Strategy pattern with OCRProvider ABC. Initial providers: Tesseract, EasyOCR, Gemini Vision. Integrate into pdf_parser to auto-OCR pages with 0 text but images present.

data.description: Implement ForumIAS parser using the Gatekeeper Strategy. data.title: Implement ForumIAS Parser with Gatekeeper Strategy
